in_sanskrit.name: द्न्येश्वर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who governs and protects Dharma (righteousness), the cosmic law and order.

in_tamil.name: தின்யேஷ்வர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who governs and protects the dharma (cosmic law and order) in every moment.

in_telugu.name: ద్న్యేశ్వర
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who governs and protects Dharma (righteousness).

in_marathi.name: Dnyneshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dnyneshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। DNYANESHWAR is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words - DNYANA (knowledge) and ISHWAR (God). It refers to the Supreme God, the Lord of the universe, who bestows the knowledge and wisdom to his devotees.
